NE-2025-LR407.title: Interim study to examine revitalization of urban areas and how cities and villages may utilize the role of culture as a driver of economic development, workforce attraction, tourism, and community revitalization in Nebraska
NE-2025-LR407.aiSummary: Would direct the Urban Affairs Committee to study how culture could help revive Nebraska cities and villages through economic growth, jobs, tourism, and community renewal. The study would also look at possible pilot cultural districts or a statewide cultural title, plus how these ideas might affect underserved communities and different parts of the state. After the study, the committee would report its findings and recommendations to the Legislature or Legislative Council.

NE-2025-LR442.title: Interim study to examine youth sports participation in the State of Nebraska, with a focus on ensuring equal access, fair play, and adequate organizational support structures for children and youth
NE-2025-LR442.aiSummary: A legislative resolution would set up an interim study on youth sports participation in Nebraska. The study would look at equal access, fair play rules, barriers to joining, and the support for fields, centers, and youth groups. The Education Committee would do the study and then report its findings and recommendations to the Legislature.

NE-2025-LR372.title: Interim study to examine the Nebraska Public Employees Retirement Systems administered by the Public Employees Retirement Board

actions.text: Referred to Nebraska Retirement Systems Committee

NE-2025-LR372.aiSummary: The resolution would direct the Nebraska Retirement Systems Committee to study the state retirement systems overseen by the Public Employees Retirement Board. The study would look at funding needs, benefits, contributions, and how each system is run, and the committee would report its findings and recommendations to lawmakers.

NE-2025-LR400.title: Interim study to examine economic development programs, policies, and incentives administered by the state

actions.text: Referred to Banking, Commerce and Insurance Committee

NE-2025-LR400.aiSummary: This resolution would direct the Revenue Committee to do an interim study on state economic development programs, policies, and incentives. The study would make a list of state-run efforts tied to economic growth, jobs, housing, infrastructure, small business, and related tax breaks or federal pass-through funds. It would also look for overlap, gaps, and ways to improve coordination, then report findings and recommendations to the Legislature.

NE-2025-LB937.aiSummary: The bill became law and changes several rules for Nebraska schools. It would create the Prior Learning Act and the K-12 Education Cybersecurity Act, and it would also change rules for student transfers, absences, option enrollment, extracurricular activities, school jobs, reports, deadlines, teacher training and hiring programs, and a college pathway program. It would also let absences be excused for a child’s physical or mental illness when a parent or guardian gives documentation from a licensed health professional, with chronic illness papers reviewed each semester.

NE-2025-LB678.aiSummary: It would set aside state money for the Board of Trustees of the Nebraska State Colleges for fiscal years 2025-26 and 2026-27. The money would help pay for wage increases in negotiated labor deals, minimum wage changes, and higher health insurance costs.
